did.unittitle: Jane Coffin Childs Memorial Fund for Medical Research, records
did.physdesc: 13 (thirteen) Paige boxes and one (1) archival letter box.
did.abstract: The records consist of grant files containing applications, progress reports, memoranda, and letters relating to work by postdoctoral fellows researching human diseases supported by the Jane Coffin Childs Memorial Fund for Medical Research.

corpname.part: Jane Coffin Childs Memorial Fund for Medical Research

prefercite.head: Preferred Citation
prefercite.p: Jane Coffin Childs Memorial Fund for Medical Research, Records (RU 1210). Manuscripts and Archives, Yale University Library.

bioghist.head: Biographical / Historical
bioghist.p: The Jane Coffin Childs Memorial Fund for Medical Research (JCC Fund) was established in 1937 by the family of Jane Coffin Childs after her passing due to cancer. Because of Yale University's investment into cancer research and the establishment of the Atypical Growth Unit, the family selected Yale Medical School as the home of the fund and endowed 3.5 million dollars to Yale University. Since then, the JCC Fund has disbursed grants to postdoctoral fellows and professors performing biomedical research relating to the causes and treatments of human diseases, especially cancer. The fund has supported over 1600 research projects at universities, hospitals, and research institutes globally since its establishment. Information in this historical note was primarily drawn from the Jane Coffin Childs Memorial Fund website, The Jane Coffin Childs Memorial Fund for Medical Research: Celebrating 75 Years of Research, 1937-2012, and the grant files found in Series 2026-A-0010: Grant Files.

odd.head: General
odd.p: Forms part of Record Group 27-E (YRG 27E), Records of departments, offices, programs, and projects of the Yale School of Medicine.

accessrestrict.head: Conditions Governing Access
accessrestrict.p: The collection is open for research.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: The records consist of grant files containing applications, progress reports, memoranda, and letters relating to grant recipients and their projects.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: The records are arranged by accession.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: Contents are arranged according to project number assigned by the Jane Coffin Childs Fund.
